relationship_to_prior_protocol.design_information_used: Only pre-outcome source availability/coverage diagnostics. No 2026 prices, returns or outcomes were loaded.

purpose: Test whether pre-anchor qualitative documentary evidence of reinvestment runway, business moat and commercial optionality improves three-year multibagger concentration when scored under the already-frozen evidence rubric.
entry_rule: first valid NSE EQ trading day strictly after anchor_date
outcome_rule: last valid NSE EQ trading day on or before outcome_target_date
sample_rule: same deterministic outcome-blind 80-company NSE EQ sample already frozen under documentary_forward_evidence_protocol_v1

features.category_scoring: 20 points per independently APPROVED runway category, cap 100, as frozen in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json
20 points per independently APPROVED moat category, cap 100, as frozen in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json
20 points per independently APPROVED optionality category, cap 100, as frozen in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json

ranking_eligibility.score_rule: weighted earned/covered normalization using effective 100-point weights only for covered approved qualitative features

evaluation.decision_rule: Positive diagnostic requires either higher mean multiple or higher 5x concentration, no more than 5 percentage points adverse loss-rate delta, and non-negative rank correlation. One anchor can justify further holdouts but cannot change official weights.

explicit_non_claims: This test does not validate the failed numeric+qualitative documentary protocol.
This is not the full Growth Runway, Business Moat or Future Catalysts pillar.
Qualitative evidence indices are not direct return forecasts.
No 100-point RK-MIS weight may be changed from this single holdout.

outcome_safety.corporate_actions: deterministic factors only; unresolved material actions fail closed
